The '''military rank''' was the established order of commanding responsibility between the [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of a military force.

==Galactic Republic==
The ranks held by members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]] varied by era, for instance, during the [[Old Sith Wars]] the rank of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], or more accurately [[Fleet Captain/Legends|Fleet Captain]] was used to refer to [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] was given as a general title reflecting someone in command but not as a specific rank. Also, due to the diversity of the members of the military, regulations specified that any personnel of higher rank than oneself, regardless of the species, gender or position was to be addressed as "sir". The military answered ultimately to the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Though the [[Republic Army]] and [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] had similar ranks, there were some variations.<ref name="SWTORcodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Republic Military Ranks}}</ref>

During the [[New Sith Wars]], the Republic Army was briefly reorganized as the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] with a [[Jedi Lord]] in command. After the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] the Republic Military was officially disbanded. The [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Forces]] became the Republic's main fighting force. The ranks of the [[Judicial/Legends|Judicials]] were very basic and the force itself was relatively small as they depended on the support of the [[Planetary Security Forces]] which had widely varying ranks.<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

With the eruption of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the Republic created a new military. The Judicial Forces became a part of the new Republic Navy. The army of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] secretly created on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] became the backbone of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. The separate [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps]] and [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] were also added. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] took command of the military coordinated by the [[Jedi command/Legends|Jedi Command]] and under the supervision of the Senate. Along with [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commanders]], clones with special training were given ranks of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] to assist in leading the army. Later, Supreme Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was given ultimate command as the [[Supreme Commander]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Confederacy of Independent Systems==
[[File:Grievous_Son_of_Dathomir.png|thumb|200px|The [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] Grievous held the military rank of General]]
The highest rank in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] was that of [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], held by [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who was also given the rank of [[General/Legends|General]].

==Alliance to Restore the Republic==
The highest rank in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Military/Legends|Military]] was [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]], while in the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Army]] it was [[General/Legends|General]]. Seven known Rebel generals were [[Roons Sewell]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] and [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]]. The title of [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] was given to the head of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]&mdash;such as [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]&mdash;or to the overall leader of the Alliance&mdash;[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]. This title remained in use in the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].

==Galactic Empire==
With the founding of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Republic Military became the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] with ground forces being divided between the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. The highest rank in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] was [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Military Executor]]/[[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[Grand General/Legends|Grand General]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. [[Malcor Brashin]] was a notable Imperial Grand General and [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] (Thrawn), [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and [[Morlish Veed]] are examples of famous Grand Admirals. In the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and the later [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]], '''[[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]]''' was the highest rank.
